security_audit.summary: Most static hits are Markdown fences, inline backticks, or documentation references rather than hidden executable code. I found two contextual risks: mutable npx package execution and a debug example that logs all environment variables. No prompt injection text was found in the reviewed files.

remediation.issue: Mutable package execution through npx claude-flow@alpha
remediation.suggestion: Pin a reviewed stable version or commit. Require explicit user approval before downloading and executing external packages.

remediation.issue: Debug workflow prints the full environment
remediation.suggestion: Replace env | sort with an allowlist of safe diagnostics. Never print tokens, secrets, or deployment credentials.

remediation.issue: Workflow examples can push branches and open pull requests
remediation.suggestion: State that write actions need user confirmation and should run on a branch with least-privilege credentials.

semantic_findings.description: The skill tells users to run npx claude-flow@alpha. A mutable prerelease package can change without review and execute local code.
semantic_findings.confidence_reasoning: The file directly instructs npx execution with the mutable @alpha tag. This is legitimate tooling, but it is a clear supply-chain risk.

content.value_statement: GitHub Actions workflows can become slow, fragile, and hard to secure. This skill guides Claude, Codex, and Claude Code through structured CI/CD design, tuning, and review.
actual_capabilities: Guides creation of GitHub Actions CI/CD workflows from project requirements.
Coordinates specialized agent roles for workflow design, testing, security, and performance.
Suggests matrix testing, caching, artifact handling, and conditional execution patterns.
Provides workflow debugging steps for failed runs and flaky tests.
Recommends security controls such as minimal permissions and pinned actions.
limitations: It provides guidance and examples, not a complete workflow generation engine.
Referenced scripts and templates are described, but they are not included in this skill directory.
Some commands require GitHub access, repository write permissions, or installed local tools.
External tools and packages should be reviewed before execution.

use_cases.title: Create a New CI Pipeline
use_cases.description: Design a GitHub Actions workflow with linting, tests, builds, security scans, and deployment gates.

use_cases.title: Improve Slow Workflows
use_cases.description: Review execution metrics and add caching, path filters, and parallel jobs to reduce run time.

use_cases.title: Harden Workflow Security
use_cases.description: Review token permissions, action pinning, secrets handling, and scanning coverage before production use.

prompt_templates.title: Draft a Basic CI Workflow
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner request for a new repository workflow.
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a GitHub Actions CI workflow for this repository. Include triggers, dependency install, tests, and a build job.

prompt_templates.title: Add Matrix Testing
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate request for broader test coverage.
prompt_templates.prompt: Update my workflow plan to test multiple operating systems and runtime versions. Explain the matrix choices and expected cost.

prompt_templates.title: Optimize Existing Workflow Speed
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this workflow and identify slow steps. Recommend caching, parallelization, and path filters with clear tradeoffs.

prompt_templates.title: Audit a Deployment Workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Audit this deployment workflow for token scope, action pinning, secret exposure, approval gates, rollback, and supply-chain risk.

output_examples.input: A Node.js project needs CI on pull requests and pushes to main.
output_examples.output: A workflow plan with checkout, setup, dependency caching, linting, tests, build, and minimal token permissions.

output_examples.input: A workflow is slow because tests and builds run in sequence.
output_examples.output: A performance review that separates independent jobs, adds cache keys, and limits runs to relevant path changes.

output_examples.input: A deployment workflow uses broad token permissions and unpinned actions.
output_examples.output: A security review that narrows permissions, pins actions to trusted revisions, and adds approval controls.

best_practices: Review every generated workflow before committing it to the repository.
Use least-privilege permissions and pin third-party actions to reviewed revisions.
Test workflow changes on a feature branch before merging to main.
anti_patterns: Do not run external packages or scripts without reviewing the source and version.
Do not print full environment variables or secrets in workflow logs.
Do not grant broad repository permissions when a job only needs read access.

faq.question: Does this skill create workflow files automatically?
faq.answer: It provides structured guidance and examples. File creation still depends on the AI tool and user approval.

faq.question: Can it optimize existing GitHub Actions workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It guides analysis of run history, cache usage, job dependencies, and path filters.

faq.question: Does it support deployment workflows?
faq.answer: Yes. It covers deployment jobs, approvals, rollback planning, and status checks.

faq.question: Is it safe to run every command shown?
faq.answer: No. Review external packages, scripts, credentials, and write operations before execution.

faq.question: Which AI tools can use this skill?
faq.answer: The report lists support for Claude, Codex, and Claude Code.

faq.question: What security practices does it recommend?
faq.answer: It recommends minimal token permissions, pinned third-party actions, secrets management, and security scanning.
